title: Rust: Middleware Pipeline
description: Build a middleware pipeline for processing requests and responses.

steps.title: Define Request and Response
steps.description: Define `Request` struct with `path: String`, `method: String`, `headers: HashMap<String, String>`. Define `Response` struct with `status: u16`, `body: String`. Create sample request.
hints: `struct Request { path: String, method: String, headers: HashMap<String, String> }`

verification.failureMessage: Create and print a sample request.

steps.title: Middleware Trait
steps.description: Define a trait `Middleware` with `fn handle(&self, req: &mut Request, res: &mut Response)`. Implement `LoggingMiddleware` that prints the request method and path.
hints: `trait Middleware { fn handle(&self, req: &mut Request, res: &mut Response); }`
LoggingMiddleware prints `"METHOD /path"` then calls `next(req, res)` or continues.
For now, just print and modify the response.

verification.failureMessage: Run LoggingMiddleware on a request and print the log output.

steps.title: Middleware Chain
steps.description: Create a `MiddlewareChain` that holds a `Vec<Box<dyn Middleware>>`. Add a `handle(mut req: Request, mut res: Response) -> Response` method that runs all middleware in order.
hints: `fn add(&mut self, m: Box<dyn Middleware>)` adds to the chain.

verification.failureMessage: Run a middleware chain on a request.

steps.title: Auth Middleware
steps.description: Implement an `AuthMiddleware` that checks for an Authorization header. If missing, set status to 401 and short-circuit. Add it to the chain before LoggingMiddleware.
hints: Short-circuit by returning early (skip remaining middleware).

verification.failureMessage: Test with missing Authorization header to get 401.

steps.title: Full Pipeline with Multiple Middleware
steps.description: Create a pipeline with 3 middleware: `AuthMiddleware`, `LoggingMiddleware`, and an `AddHeaderMiddleware` that adds a `X-Response-Time` header. Test with a valid request that passes all middleware.
hints: Add all 3 to the chain in order.
AddHeaderMiddleware adds a custom response header.

verification.failureMessage: Run all 3 middleware and print the final response.
